info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Invoices-v2-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Invoices Retrieval API enables users to efficiently access and retrieve a list of invoices associated with retail orders. This API caters to businesses that need to monitor and manage their invoices for better financial oversight and reporting. Typical consumers include retailers, accounting teams, and financial analysts who require invoice data for reconciliation, auditing, or operational purposes. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their invoice management workflows and enhance their overall operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve an invoice for a specific order
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the invoice details for a specified order, providing essential information such as order items, pricing, and due dates. Use this to get a complete view of the order's financial aspects.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the required parameters to retrieve an invoice for orders. The client must provide necessary identifiers or filters to obtain the specific invoice details.

204.description: Request processed successfully with no content returned.

ListRetailOrdersInvoicesRequest.title: Invoice Request Body
ListRetailOrdersInvoicesRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the Invoice operations within the Orders API. It represents the data structure expected when making a GET request to retrieve invoice data.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the invoice.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the invoice.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListRetailOrdersInvoicesResponse_204.description: Schema representing the response structure for the GET operation on orders invoice.

createdBy.description: The user who created the invoice.

createdAt.description: Timestamp for when the invoice was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the invoice creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information for the invoice.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken for the processing of the request, measured in milliseconds.
